sources.snippet: This page provides a deep dive into the Qwen3.5-4B model architecture as implemented in the fast inference stack. The model utilizes a hybrid architecture combining GatedDeltaNet (GDN) linear attention with standard full-attention layers to achieve high throughput while maintaining long-context reasoning capabilities.
